subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu group chats automatically provision per-sender subagents with isolated skills/config/memory, or should supported isolation remain sender/topic session scopes plus explicit agent bindings?
rationale: Current code has useful partial primitives, but the requested default changes channel routing, agent lifecycle, config writes, per-user skills, memory boundaries, permissions, and cleanup, which requires maintainer product and security intent before implementation.

options.title: Define Feishu-owned contract first
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella product/security decision, then split approved work into narrow Feishu plugin, SDK, memory, and docs tasks with live Feishu proof.

options.title: Limit support to session scopes
options.body: Treat group_sender and group_topic_sender as the supported current group isolation model and close or rewrite automatic per-user group subagents as out of scope.

options.title: Defer to related primitives
options.body: Resolve channel threading policy and user-level skill preference issues first, then revisit automatic group subagents with clearer core/plugin APIs.

recommendation.title: Define Feishu-owned contract first
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the umbrella product/security decision, then split approved work into narrow Feishu plugin, SDK, memory, and docs tasks with live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names @m1heng as the Feishu plugin community owner, and this is primarily a Feishu product/security contract choice.
